pages.title: Bekenstein Crystal
pages.text: A crystal containing the maximum information a region of space can hold, the Bekenstein bound: proportional to the area of its surface, not its volume. Add one more bit and it would become a black hole. It is warm, glassy and dense with stored meaning.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I wrote a Holographic Matrix's information onto Hawking radiation in the Holographic Encoder, pushing it until the crystal reached its limit. Any further and it would have collapsed into a black hole.
